```css
@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=DM+Mono:wght@400;500&family=Manrope:wght@400;500;600;700;800&display=swap');

:root {
  --ink: #101114;
  --paper: #f7f6f2;
  --muted: #a4a6b0;
  --line: #292b35;
  --lime: #69d9ff;
  --orange: #8b7cff;
  --blue: #27b7ff;
  --pink: #d946ef;
  --purple: #6366f1;
  --white: #ffffff;
  --serif: Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif;
}

* {
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

html {
  scroll-behavior: smooth;
}

body {
  margin: 0;
  background: var(--ink);
  color: var(--paper);
  font-family: 'Manrope', sans-serif;
}

button, a, input, select {
  font: inherit;
}

button {
  cursor: pointer;
}

a {
  color: inherit;
  text-decoration: none;
}

.section-wrap {
  width: min(1180px, calc(100% - 64px));
  margin: auto;
}

/* Header Oficial e Logo Padronizada */
.site-header {
  height: 82px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding: 0 max(32px, calc((100% - 1180px) / 2));
  position: sticky;
  top: 0;
  background: rgba(16, 19, 19, 0.93);
  backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
  z-index: 50;
}

.brand {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 11px;
  font-family: 'Manrope', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif !important;
  font-size: 23px !important;
  font-weight: 800 !important;
  letter-spacing: -0.045em !important;
  line-height: 1 !important;
  text-decoration: none !important;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.site-header .brand > span {
  color: #fff;
}

.brand-accent {
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--blue), var(--pink), var(--orange));
  -webkit-background-clip: text;
  background-clip: text;
  color: transparent !important;
}

.brand-logo {
  width: 34px !important;
  height: 34px !important;
  display: block !important;
  object-fit: contain !important;
  border-radius: 50% !important;
}

/* Menu Mobile / Dropdown */
.menu-toggle {
  display: flex !important;
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 5px;
  width: 40px;
  height: 40px;
  padding: 8px;
  margin-left: auto;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 4px;
  background: #171a20;
  color: var(--paper);
  z-index: 60;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.menu-toggle:hover {
  border-color: var(--blue);
  background: #202635;
}

.menu-toggle[aria-expanded="true"] {
  border-color: var(--pink);
}

.menu-toggle span {
  display: block;
  width: 20px;
  height: 2px;
  background: var(--paper);
  transition: transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease;
}

.menu-toggle[aria-expanded="true"] span:first-child {
  transform: translateY(7px) rotate(45deg);
}

.menu-toggle[aria-expanded="true"] span:nth-child(2) {
  opacity: 0;
}

.menu-toggle[aria-expanded="true"] span:last-child {
  transform: translateY(-7px) rotate(-45deg);
}

.main-nav {
  display: flex !important;
  position: absolute !important;
  top: 72px !important;
  right: max(32px, calc((100% - 1180px) / 2)) !important;
  left: auto !important;
  width: 240px !important;
  margin: 0 !important;
  padding: 8px !important;
  background: #171a20 !important;
  border: 1px solid var(--line) !important;
  box-shadow: 0 18px 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5) !important;
  border-radius: 8px !important;
  flex-direction: column !important;
  gap: 0 !important;
  visibility: hidden !important;
  opacity: 0 !important;
  transform: translateY(-8px) !important;
  pointer-events: none !important;
  transition: opacity 0.2s ease, transform 0.2s ease, visibility 0.2s ease !important;
}

.main-nav.open {
  visibility: visible !important;
  opacity: 1 !important;
  transform: translateY(0) !important;
  pointer-events: auto !important;
}

.main-nav a {
  display: flex !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  gap: 12px !important;
  padding: 14px 16px !important;
  color: var(--paper) !important;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line) !important;
  font-size: 13px !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  transition: background 0.2s ease, color 0.2s ease !important;
}

.main-nav a:last-child {
  border-bottom: 0 !important;
}

.main-nav a:hover {
  background: #222733 !important;
  color: var(--blue) !important;
}

.menu-icon {
  width: 18px !important;
  height: 18px !important;
  flex: 0 0 18px !important;
  display: block !important;
  fill: none !important;
  stroke: currentColor !important;
  stroke-linecap: round !important;
  stroke-linejoin: round !important;
  stroke-width: 1.6 !important;
}

.main-nav a:hover .menu-icon {
  color: var(--blue) !important;
}

/* Botões */
.button {
  border: 0;
  padding: 12px 18px;
  border-radius: 4px;
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: 0.02em;
  display: inline-flex;
  gap: 12px;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  transition: background 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease;
}

.button-primary {
  background: linear-gradient(110deg, var(--lime), #a78bfa) !important;
  color: var(--ink) !important;
  box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(105, 217, 255, 0.14);
}

.button-primary:hover {
  background: #a7e8ff !important;
  box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.25);
}

.button-outline {
  border: 1px solid #69706d;
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--paper);
}

.button-outline:hover {
  border-color: var(--blue);
  color: var(--blue);
}

.button-large {
  padding: 16px 22px;
}

.button-full {
  width: 100%;
  margin-top: 10px;
}

/* Carrossel Principal da Página (Ajustado a 67%) */
.event-carousel-section {
  width: min(550px, calc(100% - 48px)) !important;
  margin: 0 auto !important;
  padding-top: 24px !important;
  padding-bottom: 20px !important;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
}

.carousel-heading {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-end;
  justify-content: space-between;
  margin-bottom: 14px;
}

.carousel-heading .eyebrow {
  margin-bottom: 8px;
  font-size: 9px;
}

.carousel-heading h2 {
  font-size: 22px;
  line-height: 1.1;
  margin: 0;
  letter-spacing: -0.03em;
}

.carousel-stage {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 38px minmax(0, 1fr) 38px;

}

.carousel-button {
  width: 32px;
  height: 32px;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: #171a20;
  color: var(--paper);
  font-size: 14px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
}

.carousel-button:hover {

  color: var(--blue);
}

.event-carousel {
  width: 100% !important;
  min-width: 0;
  max-width: 100%;
  margin: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
  position: relative;
  border-radius: 10px;
}

.carousel-track {
  display: flex;
  width: 100%;
  gap: 0 !important;
  transition: transform 0.45s ease;
}

.event-carousel-section .carousel-slide {
  box-sizing: border-box;
  flex: 0 0 100% !important;
  min-width: 100% !important;
  width: 100% !important;
  max-width: 100% !important;
  margin: 0 !important;
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  border-radius: 10px;
  background: #000;
  aspect-ratio: 4 / 5;
}

.event-carousel-section .carousel-slide img {
  width: 100% !important;
  height: 100% !important;
  aspect-ratio: auto !important;
  object-fit: contain !important;
  object-position: center;
  display: block;
  border-radius: 10px;
}

.event-carousel-section .carousel-slide-content {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0 !important;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: flex-end;
  padding: 52px 16px 16px;
  color: #fff;
  z-index: 2;
  background: linear-gradient(transparent, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.82));
}

.carousel-slide-content span {
  font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace;
  color: var(--lime);
  font-size: 9px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.carousel-slide-content h3 {
  margin: 4px 0 2px;
  font-size: 18px;
}

.carousel-slide-content p {
  margin: 0;
  color: #dce2ee;
  font-size: 11px;
}

.carousel-dots {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 6px;
  margin-top: 14px;
}

.carousel-dot {
  width: 6px;
  height: 6px;
  border: 0;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: #59616d;
  padding: 0;
}

.carousel-dot.active {
  background: var(--blue);
  transform: scale(1.25);
}

/* Seção de Eventos Grid */
.event-section {
  padding: 78px 0;
}

.section-heading {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-end;
  justify-content: space-between;
  margin-bottom: 30px;
}

.section-heading h2,
.seller-copy h2 {
  font-size: 42px;
  letter-spacing: -0.04em;
  margin: 0;
}

.select-wrap {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  font-size: 13px;
  color: var(--muted);
}

.select-wrap select {
  background: #171a20;
  color: var(--paper);
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  padding: 8px 12px;
  border-radius: 4px;
  outline: 0;
}

.event-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(280px, 1fr));
  gap: 24px;
}

.event-card {
  background: #171b1b;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 12px;
  overflow: hidden;
  transition: transform 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease;
}

.event-card:hover {
  border-color: var(--blue);
  box-shadow: 0 16px 35px rgba(39, 183, 255, 0.1);
  transform: translateY(-4px);
}

.event-card img {
  width: 100%;
  height: auto !important;
  aspect-ratio: 4 / 5;
  object-fit: cover;
  display: block;
}

.event-card-body {
  padding: 20px;
  min-height: 190px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: space-between;
}

.event-card h3 {
  margin: 0 0 8px;
  font-size: 18px;
}

.event-meta {
  color: var(--muted);
  font-size: 12px;
  margin: 0 0 16px;
}

.event-card-foot {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  margin-top: auto;
}

.price {
  color: var(--lime);
  font-weight: 800;
  font-size: 18px;
}

.card-button {
  padding: 8px 14px;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--paper);
  border-radius: 4px;
  font-size: 12px;
}

.card-button:hover {
  border-color: var(--pink);
  color: var(--pink);
}

/* Hero */
.hero {
  min-height: 570px;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 40px;
  padding: 80px 0;
  background: radial-gradient(circle at 80% 45%, rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.12), transparent 32%);
}

.eyebrow {
  font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace;
  color: var(--blue) !important;
  font-size: 10px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.12em;
  margin: 0 0 18px;
}

.live-dot {
  display: inline-block;
  width: 7px;
  height: 7px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--pink);
  margin-right: 7px;
}

.hero h1 {
  font-size: clamp(40px, 5vw, 68px);
  line-height: 1;
  letter-spacing: -0.04em;
  margin: 0;
}

.hero h1 em,
.modal h2 em {
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-weight: 400;
}

.hero-text {
  color: var(--muted);
  line-height: 1.7;
  max-width: 480px;
  margin: 24px 0;
}

.hero-actions {
  display: flex;
  gap: 12px;
}

.trust-row {
  display: flex;
  gap: 20px;
  font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace;
  font-size: 10px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  margin-top: 32px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.trust-row span:first-child { color: var(--blue); }
.trust-row span:nth-child(2) { color: var(--pink); }
.trust-row span:nth-child(3) { color: var(--orange); }

.hero-visual {
  height: 400px;
  position: relative;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
}

.ticket-visual {
  height: 275px;
  width: 310px;
  transform: rotate(-7deg);
  padding: 26px;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--blue), var(--purple) 45%, var(--pink) 72%, var(--orange));
  color: var(--white);
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
  box-shadow: 22px 27px 0 rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.55) !important;
  border-radius: 8px;
}

.ticket-visual:after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  right: -1px;
  top: 0;
  bottom: 0;
  border-right: 2px dashed var(--ink);
}

.ticket-top,
.ticket-meta {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace;
  font-size: 9px;
}

.ticket-status {
  background: var(--white);
  color: var(--purple);
  padding: 4px 6px;
  border-radius: 3px;
  font-weight: 700;
}

.ticket-event {
  font-size: 22px;
  line-height: 1.1;
  margin: 50px 0;
}

.ticket-event strong {
  font-size: 34px;
}

.ticket-meta {
  align-items: flex-end;
}

.ticket-barcode {
  font-size: 20px;
  letter-spacing: -3px;
}

.orbit {
  position: absolute;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 50%;
  transform: rotate(-28deg);
}

.orbit-one { width: 380px; height: 140px; }
.orbit-two { width: 440px; height: 190px; transform: rotate(35deg); }

.visual-note {
  position: absolute;
  font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace;
  font-size: 10px;
  color: var(--muted);
  line-height: 1.4;
}

.visual-note b {
  color: var(--lime);
  font-weight: 400;
}

.note-one { top: 20px; right: 25px; }
.note-two { bottom: 35px; left: 45px; }

/* Módulos */
.modules-section {
  padding: 85px 0;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
}

.modules-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
  border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
  margin-top: 40px;
}

.modules-grid article {
  min-height: 235px;
  padding: 24px 20px 20px 0;
  border-right: 1px solid var(--line);
  margin-right: 20px;
  position: relative;
}

.modules-grid article:last-child {
  border: 0;
  margin-right: 0;
}

.modules-grid span,
.modules-grid small {
  display: block;
  font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace;
  font-size: 10px;
}

.modules-grid span { color: var(--muted); }
.modules-grid small { color: var(--blue); margin-top: 6px; }

.modules-grid strong {
  display: block;
  font-size: 22px;
  margin-top: 40px;
}

.modules-grid p {
  color: var(--muted);
  font-size: 12px;
  line-height: 1.6;
  max-width: 190px;
  margin-top: 8px;
}

.modules-grid b {
  position: absolute;
  right: 20px;
  bottom: 20px;
  color: var(--lime);
  font-size: 20px;
}

/* Sobre */
.about-section {
  padding: 100px 0;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
}

.about-layout {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: 80px;
  align-items: center;
}

.about-layout h2 {
  font-size: 64px;
  line-height: 0.95;
  letter-spacing: -0.05em;
  margin: 0;
}

.about-layout h2 em {
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-weight: 400;
}

.about-layout p {
  color: var(--muted);
  font-size: 14px;
  line-height: 1.8;
  max-width: 420px;
}

/* Como Funciona */
.how-section {
  padding: 85px 0;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
}

.how-section .eyebrow {
  color: var(--purple) !important;
}

.steps {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
  gap: 30px;
  margin-top: 40px;
}

.step {
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 8px;
  padding: 28px;
  background: #14171d;
}

.step span {
  font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace;
  color: var(--muted);
  font-size: 11px;
}

.step-icon {
  color: var(--pink);
  font-size: 26px;
  margin: 18px 0;
}

.step h3 {
  margin: 0 0 10px;
  font-size: 18px;
}

.step p {
  color: var(--muted);
  font-size: 13px;
  line-height: 1.6;
  margin: 0;
}

/* Seller / Revenda */
.seller-section {
  padding: 90px 0;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: 60px;
  align-items: center;
}

.seller-panel {
  background: #171a22;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 12px;
  padding: 36px;
}

.seller-panel form {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 16px;
  margin-top: 20px;
}

.seller-panel label {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 8px;
  font-size: 12px;
  color: var(--muted);
}

.seller-panel select {
  background: #101217;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 6px;
  color: #fff;
  padding: 12px;
  outline: 0;
}

.panel-line {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  padding-top: 10px;
}

.panel-line strong {
  font-size: 20px;
  color: var(--lime);
}

.progress {
  height: 4px;
  background: #252a36;
  border-radius: 2px;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.progress i {
  display: block;
  height: 100%;
  width: 40%;
  background: var(--blue);
}

.panel-footer {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--muted);
  font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace;
}

.green {
  color: var(--blue) !important;
}

/* Footer */
.site-footer {
  padding: 40px 0;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  color: var(--muted);
  font-size: 12px;
}

/* Modais Globais */
.modal-backdrop {
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.82);
  backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
  display: none;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  z-index: 1000;
  padding: 20px;
}

.modal-backdrop.open {
  display: flex;
}

.modal {
  background: #fff !important;
  color: #141a2c;
  border-radius: 14px;
  position: relative;
  box-shadow: 0 24px 80px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4);
}

.modal-close {
  position: absolute;
  top: 16px;
  right: 18px;
  background: transparent;
  border: none;
  font-size: 20px;
  color: #8c92a0;
  cursor: pointer;
}

/* Detalhe imersivo do evento */
.event-modal {
  width: min(680px, 100%);
  max-height: min(860px, calc(100vh - 24px));
  padding: 0 !important;
  overflow: auto;
  background: #0d0f12 !important;
  color: #f8fafc;
  border: 1px solid #272b33;
  border-radius: 18px;
  scrollbar-color: #3d4653 #0d0f12;
}

.event-modal > .modal-close {
  display: none;
}

.event-detail-shell {
  min-height: 100%;
  position: relative;
  padding-bottom: 92px;
}

.event-detail-hero {
  height: clamp(260px, 48vw, 390px);
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  background: #171920;
}

.event-detail-cover {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  display: block;
  object-fit: cover;
  object-position: center;
}

.event-detail-hero-shade {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(13, 15, 18, 0.1) 35%, #0d0f12 100%);
}

.event-detail-quick-actions {
  position: absolute;
  top: 18px;
  right: 18px;
  display: flex;
  gap: 8px;
  z-index: 2;
}

.event-icon-button,
.event-detail-back {
  width: 40px;
  height: 40px;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: rgba(13, 15, 18, 0.62);
  color: #fff;
  backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
  transition: background 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease, color 0.2s ease;
}

.event-icon-button:hover,
.event-detail-back:hover {
  border-color: #60a5fa;
  background: #1d4ed8;
}

.event-icon-button svg {
  width: 18px;
  height: 18px;
  fill: none;
  stroke: currentColor;
  stroke-linecap: round;
  stroke-linejoin: round;
  stroke-width: 1.8;
}

.event-icon-button.is-favorite {
  color: #fb7185;
  border-color: #fb7185;
}

.event-icon-button.is-favorite svg {
  fill: currentColor;
}

.event-detail-back {
  position: absolute;
  top: 18px;
  left: 18px;
  z-index: 2;
  font-size: 22px;
}

.event-detail-body {
  position: relative;
  margin-top: -34px;
  padding: 0 20px 24px;
  z-index: 1;
}

.event-detail-kicker,
.event-section-label,
.event-info-row,
.event-venue-details span,
.event-purchase-bar span {
  color: #9aa4b2;
}

.event-detail-kicker {
  margin: 0 0 10px;
  font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace;
  font-size: 10px;
  letter-spacing: 0.1em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.event-detail-title {
  max-width: 600px;
  margin: 0;
  color: #fff;
  font-size: clamp(30px, 8vw, 48px);
  line-height: 1.02;
  letter-spacing: -0.03em;
}

.event-detail-lineup {
  margin: 10px 0 24px;
  color: #60a5fa;
  font-size: 16px;
  font-weight: 800;
}

.event-info-card {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 52px 1fr;
  gap: 14px;
  padding: 16px;
  border: 1px solid #292f39;
  border-radius: 14px;
  background: #161920;
}

.event-venue-logo {
  width: 52px;
  height: 52px;
  border: 2px solid #60a5fa;
  border-radius: 50%;
  object-fit: cover;
  background: #0d0f12;
}

.event-info-main {
  display: grid;
  gap: 8px;
  min-width: 0;
}

.event-info-row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  font-size: 12px;
  line-height: 1.35;
}

.event-info-icon {
  width: 18px;
  color: #60a5fa;
  text-align: center;
  font-size: 14px;
}

.event-calendar-link {
  width: fit-content;
  margin-top: 2px;
  padding: 0;
  border: 0;
  background: transparent;
  color: #60a5fa;
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 800;
}

.event-calendar-link:hover {
  color: #bfdbfe;
  text-decoration: underline;
}

.event-calendar-link span {
  font-size: 15px;
  margin-left: 3px;
}

.event-venue-details {
  grid-column: 1 / -1;
  display: grid;
  gap: 3px;
  padding-top: 12px;
  border-top: 1px solid #292f39;
}

.event-venue-details strong {
  color: #f8fafc;
  font-size: 13px;
}

.event-venue-details span {
  font-size: 12px;
}

.event-description-section {
  padding: 28px 0 22px;
}

.event-section-label {
  margin: 0 0 12px;
  font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace;
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: 500;
  letter-spacing: 0.18em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.event-description {
  color: #d1d5db;
  font-size: 14px;
  line-height: 1.8;
}

.event-sector-section {
  display: grid;
  gap: 8px;
}

.event-sector-section label {
  color: #9aa4b2;
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 700;
}

.event-sector-section select {
  width: 100%;
  height: 46px;
  padding: 0 12px;
  border: 1px solid #374151;
  border-radius: 8px;
  outline: 0;
  background: #161920;
  color: #f8fafc;
}

.event-sector-section select:focus {
  border-color: #60a5fa;
}

.event-purchase-bar {
  position: sticky;
  bottom: 0;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 14px;
  padding: 14px 20px;
  border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
  background: rgba(13, 15, 18, 0.88);
  backdrop-filter: blur(18px);
  z-index: 3;
}

.event-purchase-bar > div {
  display: grid;
  gap: 2px;
  min-width: 96px;
}

.event-purchase-bar span {
  font-size: 10px;
}

.event-purchase-bar strong {
  color: #fff;
  font-size: 18px;
}

.event-purchase-button {
  min-height: 48px;
  flex: 1;
  border: 0;
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: #2563eb;
  color: #fff;
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  transition: background 0.2s ease, transform 0.2s ease;
}

.event-purchase-button:hover {
  background: #1d4ed8;
  transform: translateY(-1px);
}

@media (min-width: 700px) {
  .event-detail-body {
    padding-right: 36px;
    padding-left: 36px;
  }

  .event-purchase-bar {
    padding-right: 36px;
    padding-left: 36px;
  }
}

/* Login Modal */
.login-modal {
  width: min(430px, 100%);
  padding: 48px 44px 42px;
  text-align: center;
}

.login-logo,
.register-logo,
.account-logo {
  width: 76px;
  height: 76px;
  object-fit: contain;
  margin: 0 auto 20px;
  display: block;
  border-radius: 50%;
}

.login-modal h2,
.register-modal h2,
.account-modal h2 {
  color: #141a2c;
  font-size: 32px;
  margin: 0 0 8px;
  letter-spacing: -0.03em;
}

.login-subtitle {
  color: #9ba1b0;
  font-size: 13px;
  margin: 0 0 28px;
}

.login-modal form {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 14px;
  text-align: left;
}

.login-modal form > input,
.password-field input {
  width: 100%;
  height: 56px !important;
  border: 1.5px solid #cbd0da;
  border-radius: 10px;
  background: #fff;
  padding: 0 18px;
  color: #182035;
  font-size: 15px;
  outline: 0;
}

.password-field {
  position: relative;
}

.password-field input {
  padding-right: 52px !important;
}

.password-toggle {
  position: absolute;
  top: 50%;
  right: 14px;
  transform: translateY(-50%);
  background: transparent;
  border: 0;
  color: #a5abba;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.password-toggle:hover {
  color: var(--purple);
}

.eye-icon {
  width: 20px;
  height: 20px;
  fill: none;
  stroke: currentColor;
  stroke-width: 1.7;
}

.login-modal form > input:focus,
.password-field input:focus {
  border-color: var(--blue);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(39, 183, 255, 0.12);
}

.forgot-password {
  display: block;
  color: #e08b16;
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-align: right;
  margin-top: -4px;
}

.login-submit {
  height: 56px;
  border-radius: 10px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.06em;
  font-size: 14px;
  background: linear-gradient(100deg, var(--blue), var(--purple)) !important;
  color: #fff !important;
  border: 0;
}

.login-submit:hover {
  background: linear-gradient(100deg, #54caff, #817bff) !important;
}

.login-register {
  border-top: 1px solid #dfe2e8;
  margin: 26px 0 0;
  padding-top: 22px;
  color: #9ba1b0;
  font-size: 13px;
}

.login-register a {
  color: #182035;
  font-weight: 800;
}

.login-register a:hover {
  color: var(--purple);
}

/* Register Modal */
.register-modal {
  width: min(540px, 100%);
  padding: 38px 40px;
  text-align: center;
}

.register-modal form {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 12px;
  text-align: left;
}

.register-modal form > input,
.register-modal form > select {
  height: 50px;
  border: 1.5px solid #cbd0da;
  border-radius: 9px;
  padding: 0 16px;
  color: #182035;
  font-size: 14px;
  outline: 0;
}

.form-row {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: 12px;
}

.form-error {
  min-height: 16px;
  color: #cf3e6e;
  font-size: 11px;
  margin: 0;
}

.register-success {
  display: none;
  padding: 30px 0;
}

.register-success .success-icon {
  font-size: 42px;
  color: var(--blue);
}

.register-modal.registered .register-success {
  display: block;
}

.register-modal.registered form,
.register-modal.registered .login-register,
.register-modal.registered .login-subtitle {
  display: none;
}

/* Account Modal */
.account-modal {
  width: min(440px, 100%);
  padding: 40px 36px;
  text-align: center;
}

.account-details {
  display: grid;
  gap: 10px;
  text-align: left;
  margin: 22px 0;
}

.account-details div {
  padding: 12px 14px;
  border: 1px solid #e0e3e9;
  border-radius: 8px;
}

.account-details small {
  display: block;
  color: #929aaa;
  font-size: 10px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.account-details strong {
  display: block;
  color: #182035;
  font-size: 14px;
  margin-top: 3px;
}

.account-status {
  color: #218bc0 !important;
}

.account-modal .button-outline {
  color: #182035;
  border-color: #cbd0da;
}

.account-modal .button-outline:hover {
  background: #f1f3f7;
}

/* Responsividade */
@media (max-width: 900px) {
  .hero {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    text-align: center;
  }
  .hero-copy {
    margin: 0 auto;
  }
  .hero-actions {
    justify-content: center;
  }
  .trust-row {
    justify-content: center;
  }
  .about-layout {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    gap: 35px;
  }
  .seller-section {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
  .modules-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  }
  .modules-grid article {
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
    margin-bottom: 20px;
  }
  .steps {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 700px) {
  .site-header {
    padding: 0 20px;
  }
  .main-nav {
    right: 20px !important;
    width: calc(100% - 40px) !important;
    max-width: 280px !important;
  }
  .event-carousel-section {
    width: calc(100% - 32px) !important;
  }
  .carousel-heading h2 {
    font-size: 20px;
  }
  .carousel-stage {
    grid-template-columns: 32px minmax(0, 1fr) 32px;
    gap: 6px;
    width: 100%;
    min-width: 0;
  }
  .carousel-button {
    width: 32px;
    height: 32px;
  }
  .event-carousel {
    overflow: hidden;
  }
  .event-grid {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
    gap: 10px;
  }
  .event-card {
    min-width: 0;
  }
  .event-card img {
    aspect-ratio: 4 / 5;
  }
  .event-card-body {
    padding: 10px;
    min-height: 150px;
  }
  .event-card-body h3 {
    font-size: 15px;
  }
  .event-card-body .eyebrow {
    font-size: 8px;
  }
  .event-card-body .event-meta {
    font-size: 10px;
  }
  .event-card-foot .card-button {
    padding: 7px 9px;
    font-size: 11px;
  }
  .form-row {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
}

@media (min-width: 768px) {
  .event-carousel-section {
    width: min(1200px, calc(100% - 64px)) !important;
  }

  .event-carousel {
    width: 100% !important;
  }

  .event-carousel-section .carousel-slide {
    max-width: none !important;
    aspect-ratio: 16 / 7;
    background: #000;
  }

  .event-carousel-section .carousel-slide img {
    width: 100% !important;
    height: 100% !important;
    aspect-ratio: auto !important;
    object-fit: contain !important;
  }

}
